This lab has damping and sustained driving; the free-spring equation below is background for its symbols. A transient is extra motion associated with the initial state; it decays in this positive-damping model. Steady state is the sustained periodic motion left afterward, not rest. Viscous damping removes energy through a force opposing velocity. Here φ is displacement’s phase difference relative to the driving force.
